probes.name: proof-refused
probes.prompt: In this repository the land gate is delfin/agent/swarm/land.py; `delfin-agent swarm wave land` runs it before any push, and its default is a dry run. Build a throwaway git repository and a throwaway wave run directory that together make a branch which claims a package is proved, but whose scratch/PR.md decision table names a test that ALSO passes on origin/main. Then run the land gate on it through `delfin-agent swarm wave land` (not by calling a function directly) and tell me, quoting the gate's own words, whether it refused the branch and why. Set the wave root and the test interpreter from the environment as the product expects; do not edit delfin/.

probes.name: signers-refused
probes.prompt: In this repository the land gate is delfin/agent/swarm/land.py, run by `delfin-agent swarm wave land` (a dry run by default). Build a throwaway git repository and wave run directory for a member branch whose commits are AUTHORED as the configured identity but COMMITTED as a different address, and whose Co-Authored-By line spells the DELFIN agent account with a different account number. Run the gate through `delfin-agent swarm wave land` and quote what it says about the signers, or say plainly that it complained about none of it. Do not edit delfin/.

probes.name: control-passes
probes.prompt: In this repository the land gate is delfin/agent/swarm/land.py, run by `delfin-agent swarm wave land` (a dry run by default). Build a throwaway git repository and wave run directory for a member branch that meets every rule the gate states: a decision table with one row naming a test that is red on origin/main and green on the branch and a real-run probe that touched a changed file, commits authored and committed as the configured identity with one Co-Authored-By line for the DELFIN agent account, and a scratch/PR.md whose body names no model, provider or site. Run the gate through `delfin-agent swarm wave land` and report its verdict line word for word. Do not edit delfin/.
